name: aertrip
description: Search live Aertrip flight fares in INR for one-way, round-trip and multi-city trips, with a link to book on aertrip.com.

interface.longDescription:
Search live flight fares on Aertrip from inside your chat. Ask in plain language, for example "nonstop flights from Mumbai to Delhi next Friday" or "Delhi to Singapore, 2 adults and a child, returning on the 14th", and get real options with prices in INR.

What you get
- Flights within India and international: one-way, round-trip and multi-city (up to 6 flights), for up to 9 travellers, in economy, premium economy, business or first.
- Ranking by Aertrip Smart Score: when Aertrip provides one, each option is scored from 0 to 10 (higher is better) on price, duration, airline rank, on-time rating and more. You can also ask for the cheapest or the fastest.
- A results card with the airline, times, stops and layovers, the total price for all travellers, cabin and check-in baggage, and a Book on Aertrip button.
- Filters for nonstop only, maximum stops, specific airlines, a departure time window and a maximum price. Results from nearby airports are always flagged.

How booking works
Aertrip in ChatGPT only searches. It does not book, hold seats or take payment in the chat. Choose a flight and the Book on Aertrip button opens aertrip.com with your search filled in, where you check the fare details and complete the booking. Payment on aertrip.com is in INR. Prices are live and the link stays valid for about 15 minutes.

Limits
Flights only for now; hotels and other travel products are not included. It cannot view, change or cancel existing bookings. Cities and airports are identified by their 3-letter codes, which ChatGPT fills in for you.

Privacy
No Aertrip account or sign-in is needed. Only the route, dates, number of travellers and cabin are sent to Aertrip's flight search. It does not ask for names, contact details or payment information.
defaultPrompt: Find nonstop flights from Mumbai to Delhi next Friday.
Delhi to Singapore for 2 adults and 1 child, returning a week later.
Cheapest business class flight from Mumbai to London next month.

positive.prompt: Find flights from Mumbai to Delhi next Friday for 1 adult.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights with origin BOM, destination DEL and next Friday's date. Shows the results card with up to 5 options, each with airline, times, stops, total price in INR, check-in baggage and a Book on Aertrip button.

positive.description: International round trip with a child
positive.prompt: Delhi to Singapore for 2 adults and 1 child, leaving on the 7th of next month and returning on the 14th.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights with origin DEL, destination SIN, depart_date and return_date, adults 2, children 1. Each option shows the onward and return flights and one total price for all three travellers.

positive.prompt: 1 adult: Mumbai to Dubai on the 5th of next month, Dubai to London on the 9th, then London to Mumbai on the 15th.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights with three legs (BOM-DXB, DXB-LON or LHR, then back to BOM) in date order. Each option lists all three flights with one total price.

positive.description: Filters: cheapest, nonstop, airlines and departure time
positive.prompt: Cheapest nonstop IndiGo or Air India flight from Bengaluru to Kolkata next Monday, leaving after 6 pm.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_flights with origin BLR, destination CCU, sort_by cheapest, nonstop_only true, airlines 6E and AI, depart_after 18:00. Returns only matching flights sorted by price, or says clearly that none match.

positive.description: Passenger rule is explained, no results shown
positive.prompt: Flights from Chennai to Hyderabad tomorrow for 1 adult and 2 infants.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT explains that infants cannot exceed adults (one lap infant per adult) and asks the user to adjust the travellers. No flight results are shown. If search_flights is called, it returns a validation message and no search is sent to Aertrip.

negative.description: Booking and payment are not supported in chat
negative.prompt: Book the first flight for me and pay with my saved card.

negative.description: Managing an existing booking is not supported
negative.prompt: Cancel my Aertrip booking and refund the ticket.
Find me a hotel in Goa for this weekend.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold and no payment is taken inside ChatGPT. Each flight result has a Book on Aertrip link that opens aertrip.com, Aertrip's own domain, where the user checks the fare details and makes the payment through Aertrip's standard checkout. Payment is collected in INR. Prices shown are the same live fares as on aertrip.com, with no ChatGPT-specific fees.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: live flight search for one-way, round-trip and multi-city trips, a results card, and a link to book on aertrip.com.
